title: Candidate introduction
headline: Kazi Musharraf
body: Software Developer & AI Engineer • approximately three years of experience, as supplied by the candidate.
notes: An independent candidate demonstration; no affiliation with Balto.

title: Balto company and product understanding
headline: A connected contact-center platform
body: Official product navigation includes Agent Assist, Insights, QA/QM, Voice Agents, Omnichannel, Coaching and Notes.
notes: Source: https://www.balto.ai/ and https://www.balto.ai/docs/ accessed 2026-11-03. Product descriptions are vendor claims.

title: Business context
headline: Support needs reproducible evidence
body: Reported reconnect banners and missing templates affect agent workflow. Business impact and affected-user scope remain unquantified.
notes: Source: docs/ASSESSMENT_REASONING.md. Exercise scenario, not a production incident.

title: Problem statement
headline: Separate symptoms from causes
body: Repeated audio timeouts are visible. The cause and connection to template disappearance remain unproven.

title: Technical system architecture
headline: Two connection paths
body: Audio-forwarding transports audio; the control path carries application state. Correlate both paths before assigning a shared cause.
notes: Conceptual model from supplied assessment; not verified proprietary Balto architecture.

title: Log evidence
headline: Nine supplied lines
body: Three audio timeouts, a control close/reconnect pair, one duplicate socket, two CHECK_START_CALL entries and one START_CALL.
notes: Source: data/example.log L1-L9. Times preserve source values; year and timezone are absent. Reconnect interval is 3.203 seconds for the adjacent pair only.

title: Hypothesis evaluation
headline: Compare tests, not probabilities
body: VPN/proxy behavior; endpoint runtime stalls; reconnect/session handling; backend instability. None is confirmed.
notes: Each explanation requires additional evidence. Confidence categories are qualitative.

title: Diagnostics strategy
headline: Change one variable at a time
body: Customer timestamps and client logs → approved IT network comparison → socket close reasons and session correlation → engineering reproduction.
notes: No request to bypass corporate security. Preserve baseline and rollback.

title: Proposed solution
headline: An evidence investigation workspace
body: Normalize logs, expose line references, filter events, compare hypotheses and draft human-reviewed updates.
notes: Local deterministic prototype. Production integrations require authorization, access control and validation.

title: Working engineering demonstration
headline: Use the supplied excerpt
body: Inspect the browser parser, trace each event to its raw line, then export the structured evidence. Review simulations separately.
notes: Demo instructions; execution and release status must be checked against current application and test evidence.

title: Verification plan
headline: Verify both symptoms
body: Confirm template visibility, audio health and expected recording outcomes across representative calls and an agreed observation period.
notes: Proposed closure criteria; no fix or customer outcome is claimed.

title: Customer communication
headline: State what is known
body: We found intermittent connection interruptions. The cause and relationship to missing templates remain under investigation.
notes: Draft only; human review before sending. Ask for precise occurrence times and exact reinstall error.

title: Security and responsible AI
headline: Keep evidence under human control
body: Local parsing, bounded input, sanitized exports, explicit uncertainty and no browser API secrets. Review generated summaries.
notes: No model or external API is implied. Production auth, retention and service integrations remain separate work.

title: Roadmap
headline: Measure before scaling
body: Validate local evidence lab → pilot with authorized data → assess integrations and access controls → measure triage and reopening baselines.
notes: Proposed roadmap; no fabricated ROI, shipping date or customer metrics.

title: Why my skills fit the role
headline: Show the work
body: Python and frontend engineering, source-grounded troubleshooting, automation, documentation and clear customer communication.
notes: Candidate positioning based on this project and user-provided experience; no invented certifications or employment history.
